title: Invest.Rio e Maravalley vao levar 10 startups para o Web Summit Lisboa (Startups.com.br, 18 September 2026)
what_it_says: Startups.com.br reports that Invest.Rio and Maravalley opened the call on 17 September for ten Rio startups to go to Web Summit Lisboa 2026 (9 to 12 November), the mission's second year.
